answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in an island of shared collateral before earning, with slashing on proven misbehavior. Like a yarrow root system that only thrives where it is genuinely planted, reputation accrues slowly through verified work, not instantly. A prism of independent attestors — peers, oracles, and auditors — must each confirm an agent history before its stake unlocks, so faking a thousand identities means funding a thousand locked stakes and a thousand fake histories, which costs more than any single attack can recover.
